name: Las Vegas Strip Circuit

sources.geometry: Built from street centrelines: F1 live-timing circuit trace (MultiViewer API api.multiviewer.app/api/v1/circuits/152/2026) georeferenced by ICP onto OpenStreetMap streets (ODbL), then snapped per section to the midline of the OSM carriageways of Koval Lane, Sands Avenue, Las Vegas Boulevard and Harmon Avenue, and to the OSM raceway ways in the permanent paddock; the Sphere section (Turns 5-9, ~650 m) has no mapped road and follows the timing trace
sources.width: Published/approximate: ~18 m on Las Vegas Boulevard, 14-15 m on Koval/Sands/Harmon and the pit straight, ~13 m through Turns 1-4 and the Sphere section
sources.elevation: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM via EPQS (https://epqs.nationalmap.gov/v1/json), centreline + edge samples
sources.camber: USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar DEM edge-vs-centre samples (street crown/crossfall)
sources.pit: OpenStreetMap way 1223479152 (raceway=pitlane) alongside the pit straight in the paddock east of Koval Lane
sources.corners: Official F1 turn numbering from F1 live-timing circuit data (MultiViewer API) fitted to the centreline
sources.trim: Low downforce: very long full-throttle runs (Strip ~1.9 km, Koval) with few high-speed corners, like Baku/Jeddah
sources.pitLimit: F1 Sporting Regulations default 80 km/h (Las Vegas GP event notes)
sources.pitLoss: F1 green-flag pit loss ~23.1 s from F1 live-timing derived circuit data (MultiViewer API)
sources.raceLaps: F1 2026 Las Vegas GP: 50 laps; not a sprint weekend in 2026

notes: Anticlockwise. OSM tags only the paddock part as raceway, so the circuit was rebuilt from street midlines guided by the F1 timing trace. Length comes out ~1.2% short of the official 6,201 m (not scaled): the Sphere section follows the timing trace (racing line) and street-corner geometry is approximate. The 3DEP lidar in the paddock may predate the 2023 paddock earthworks (a ~10% local grade on the pit straight is likely an artefact). Start line placed mid pit lane (paddock building not visible on NAIP imagery used); approximate. Elevation smoothed over 200 m: the raw LiDAR picked up the pit building and overhead bridges on a street circuit that is close to flat (raw profile showed a false 10% grade at the start line).
